title: Slovakian Mozzarella Balls
description: A delicious Slovakian-inspired dish of crispy mozzarella balls with a gooey centre. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Mozzarella cheese
ingredients.notes: Fresh or buffalo mozzarella work well

instructions.step: 1. In a bowl, mix together flour, breadcrumbs, and Slovakian paprika.
2. Dip each mozzarella ball into the flour mixture, then into the beaten egg, and finally back into the flour mixture to coat.
3. Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
4. Place the coated mozzarella balls on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
5. Increase the oven temperature to broil. Broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is oozy and the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
6. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
